tasbih.nothingToSave: Avval bir necha marta hisoblang, keyin saqlang.

scratch.title: O‘chirib bilib oling
scratch.intro: Yumshoq eslatmani ochish uchun qoplama ustidan barmog‘ingizni yurgizing.
scratch.sourceNote: Bu qisqa bayonlardir; iborani asosiy manbalardan tekshiring.

sunnahs.quote: Hech bir yaxshi amalni, hatto birodaringizni ochiq chehra bilan kutib olishni ham, kichik sanamang.
Alloh har bir ishda muloyimlikni sevadi.
Pause before an ordinary task and consider the good you intend. The hadith connects deeds with intentions.
Choose a manageable good deed and return to it regularly. The hadith values consistency even in small deeds.
Mention Allah’s name, eat with your right hand, and take what is nearest to you in a shared dish.
Let your words bring good. When there is nothing good to say, silence can help prevent harmful speech.
The hadith connects faith with avoiding harm to neighbours and treating guests generously.
Make ablution before bed and lie on your right side. Both actions appear in the Prophet’s guidance.
Do not postpone charity just because you can give only a little. The hadith mentions even half a date.
Share the greeting of peace. The hadith describes salam as a way to strengthen love among believers.
Helping someone through difficulty is a meaningful good deed. The hadith encourages support and easing hardship.
Seeking beneficial knowledge is worth the effort. Read thoughtfully, check sources, and ask a knowledgeable person about what is unclear.
Gentleness makes actions better. Try expressing the same idea calmly, without harshness or humiliation.
Alhamdulillah expresses praise of Allah. The hadith describes the significance of these words, remembrance, prayer and patience.

assistant.title: Islomiy yo‘lboshchi
assistant.disclaimer: Bu ma’lumot uchun yordamchi, olim yoki imomning o‘rnini bosa olmaydi.
assistant.greeting: Assalomu alaykum. Men fatvo bermasdan, Qur’on va sahih hadislar asosida ma’lumot uchun yo‘l-yo‘riq beraman. Qanday yordam bera olaman?
assistant.footnote: Shaxsiy yoki ixtilofli masala uchun bilimli mahalliy imom bilan gaplashing.

stories.title: Sizning hikoyalaringiz
stories.intro: Islomga kelish yo‘llari, shukr va boshqalarga foyda berishi mumkin bo‘lgan saboqlar uchun sokin makon.
stories.empty: Hali chop etilgan hikoyalar yo‘q. Birinchi tasdiqlangan hikoya shu yerda chiqadi.
stories.serverUnavailable: Hikoyalar uchun kiritilgan Nur serveri kerak. Serverni ishga tushiring va ilovani localhost yoki HTTPS domeningizda oching.
stories.shareHint: Har bir yuborilgan hikoya chop etilishidan oldin ko‘rib chiqiladi
stories.notice: Telefon raqami, manzil, hujjat yoki boshqa maxfiy shaxsiy ma’lumotlarni kiritmang.
stories.formIntro: Siz yuborishni tasdiqlamaguningizcha va moderator chop etmagunicha hikoyangiz maxfiy qoladi.
stories.author: Ism yoki taxallus
stories.consent: Bu hikoya ko‘rib chiqish uchun sayt moderatoriga yuborilishini va maxfiy shaxsiy ma’lumotlarni o‘z ichiga olmasligi kerakligini tushunaman.
stories.formInvalid: Ism, sarlavha, kamida 20 ta belgi kiriting va maxfiylik ogohlantirishini tasdiqlang.
stories.sendError: Hikoya yuborilmadi. Serverni tekshirib, qayta urinib ko‘ring.
